github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Match the style of the recent commit messages: Conventional Commits, lowercase after the colon, imperative mood, subject at most 50 characters, no trailing period. Use the domain terms from GLOSSARY.md (Collection, Pull Request, Repository, Thread, Vote).
Add a body, wrapped at 72 characters, only for a non-obvious why, using '-' bullets. Never use em or en dashes.
If the branch name starts with an issue number (for example 3-list-assigned-pull-requests), end the body with 'Closes #3' using that number.
